生意最好的是大型超市（生意最好的是大型超市（第22页）“守卫士兵都是李潇的部下，不认识我？”
接着，范靖把对讲机给门口的守卫，“你听听，是不是大将军的声音！”
“知道我是谁吗？我和你们李潇将军同官阶懂吗？”
接着，战承胤询问门口守卫：“放行他，他乃正三品将军麾下十五万战家军！”
守卫一听，吓得哐当把手里对讲机掉落在地上。
城门守卫跪了一地，“参见将军！”
范靖摆了摆手，“都起来，我没那么大的官威，也不至于李潇部下都不认识我！”
“行了，带路，我要去见大将军！”
马上有人带路，把范靖领到战承胤和叶苜苜所在的高楼天台上。
最高楼的天台，范靖看见一个活动板房，是战承胤的贴身侍卫和李潇的亲信们。
从板房的窗户上，不断有无人机起飞，降落。
守卫敲门，里面传来战承胤的声音，“进来！”
打开门，太空舱的空调开得很足，范靖只顾走到冰箱前，打开冰箱门拿出一瓶饮料。
猛地灌下几口，才发出感叹：“外面太特么的热了，帝都还在下雪，马上就要过年了！”
“这里热到冒烟，简直是冰火两重天！”
叶苜苜回头看了眼范靖，难怪会被关在门外！
为何？他头发剪短便罢了，还染了一个红毛，红发在城内太扎眼。
打了耳洞，戴上钻石耳钉，穿着牛仔裤，裤子上很多破洞，裤头挂了几条链子，走起路来叮叮当当地响。
上身是黑色t恤，t恤写了许多英文，脖子上挂了两套钻链。
他浑身上下都很怪异，和这个世界格格不入。
谁也没想到，染了红毛的时尚精神小伙，竟然是正三品将军！
叶苜苜笑着调侃，“你这是准备去当精神小伙？”
范靖切了声，“我这是大隐隐于市，你懂不懂？”
“不管去哪里谈生意，他们都当我是精神小伙，一开始都很鄙视我！”
“后面身份一亮相，平日里高高在上的商业大佬，对我这个红毛卑躬屈膝，點頭哈腰摸样，特别滑稽。”
说起这个，范靖响起什么，对叶苜苜反应。
“我一个人在现代囤积货物，配了死士护卫，但实在是忙不过来！”
“古代已经开放了十多个领主基地，百姓们都搬进去了！”
“城池人口一旦形成规模，百姓们的吃喝拉撒都要解决，你不能永远给他们囤货吧？”
“所以，各种店铺超市都要陆续开放！”
“我在空间里领主基地，开放店铺的步骤，古代百姓若是想开店，前期免租金三个月，他们赚钱了再补租金，六个月后生意步入正轨再收税！”
“你还别说，我在空间里的城池，绣房，成衣铺，铁匠，茶楼……这些地方生意特别好！”
“开了麻辣烫，火锅小吃铺，烧烤啤酒店……生意也超好！”
“生意最好的是大型超市，开了几家三层楼的大超市，每天人聲鼎沸，人多到得排队！”

The best business is in large supermarkets (The best business is in large supermarkets (page 22) "The guarding soldiers are all Li Xiao's subordinates, don't you know me?"
Then, Fan Jing gave the walkie-talkie to the guard at the door, "Listen, is it the general's voice?"
"Do you know who I am? Do you understand that I have the same rank as you, General Li Xiao?"
Then, Zhan Chengyin asked the guard at the door: "Let him go, he is a 150,000-strong Zhan family army under the command of a third-grade general!"
When the guard heard this, he was so frightened that he dropped the walkie-talkie in his hand to the ground.
The city gate guard knelt on the ground, "See General!"
Fan Jing waved his hand, "Everyone, get up. I don't have that much authority, and it's not like Li Xiao's subordinates don't recognize me!"
"Okay, lead the way, I want to see the general!"
Someone immediately led the way and led Fan Jing to the rooftop of the high-rise building where Zhan Chengyin and Ye Miglu were.
On the rooftop of the highest building, Fan Jing saw a prefab house containing Zhan Chengyin's personal bodyguards and Li Xiao's cronies.
From the window of the board house, drones were constantly taking off and landing.
The guard knocked on the door, and Zhan Chengyin's voice came from inside, "Come in!"
Opening the door, the air conditioner of the space capsule was turned on at full speed. Fan Jing just walked to the refrigerator, opened the refrigerator door and took out a bottle of drink.
After taking a few sips, he sighed: "It's so hot outside, it's still snowing in the Imperial Capital, and the Chinese New Year is coming soon!"
“It’s so hot here that it’s smoking hot, it’s like a world of ice and fire!”
Ye Clover looked back at Fan Jing, no wonder he was locked out!
Why? His hair was cut short and dyed red. Red hair was too eye-catching in the city.
My ears were pierced, I wore diamond earrings, and I wore jeans with many holes and a few chains hanging from the pants, which made jingling sounds when I walked.
The upper body is wearing a black T-shirt with a lot of English written on it, and two sets of diamond chains hanging around his neck.
He was weird from head to toe and was out of tune with this world.
No one expected that the fashionable and energetic young man with dyed red hair turned out to be a third-grade general!
Ye Clover smiled and teased, "Are you planning to become a spirited boy?"
Fan Jing hesitated, "I am hiding in the city, do you understand?"
"No matter where I go to discuss business, they treat me as a spirited guy and despise me at first!"
"As soon as his identity was revealed, the normally aloof business boss kowtowed to me, a red-haired man, and nodded and bowed. It was particularly funny."
Speaking of this, Fan Jing sounded something and reacted to Ye Alfalfa.
"I am hoarding goods in modern times by myself, with a bodyguard of dead soldiers, but I am really too busy!"
"More than ten lord bases have been opened in ancient times, and people have moved in!"
"Once the city's population reaches a large scale, the people's food, drink, and toilet will have to be taken care of. You can't stock them with goods forever, right?"
"So, all kinds of shops and supermarkets must be opened one after another!"
"I have a lord base in space and the steps to open a store. If people in ancient times wanted to open a store, they would be free of rent for three months in the early stage. They would pay the rent after they made money. After six months, the business would be on track and then taxes would be collected!"
"Don't tell me, my city in space, embroidery house, garment shop, blacksmith, teahouse...these places are doing very well!"
“We have opened Malatang, a hot pot snack shop, a barbecue and beer shop... and the business is also very good!”
"The best business is in the large supermarkets. Several three-story supermarkets have opened. They are crowded every day and there are so many people that you have to queue up!"
